name: Lucidspark
description: Lucidspark is a collaborative virtual whiteboard for brainstorming, agile teamwork, meeting facilitation, and project planning.
best_for: Teams that need structured brainstorming, agile sessions, mind maps, and facilitated visual planning.
features: Real-time and asynchronous brainstorming with comments, chat, and reactions
Dynamic mind maps and AI-assisted ideation
Meeting facilitation with voting, breakout boards, and presentation mode
Agile planning templates for standups, sprints, and retrospectives
Project planning with dynamic tables, frames, and paths
Integration with productivity and project management tools

alternatives.name: Miro
alternatives.description: A shared visual workspace for brainstorming, workshops, diagrams, and cross-functional planning.
alternatives.best_for: Cross-functional teams working from early ideas through structured plans.

alternatives.name: Mural
alternatives.description: A collaborative visual workspace with facilitation tools for workshops and team alignment.
alternatives.best_for: Facilitators and cross-functional teams running structured workshops.

alternatives.name: Lucidchart
alternatives.description: A structured diagramming platform for systems, processes, and organizational diagrams.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need formal process diagrams and data-linked documentation.
